text: [178] 88 catūhāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano . katamehi catūhi . idhāvuso bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu sutānañca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti no ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthūpaparikkhī hoti no ca atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti kalyāṇavāco ca hoti .pe. sandassako ca hoti .pe. sabrahmacārīnaṃ . imehi kho āvuso catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ no attano .
